design.objective: Measure quality-guided Context7 library-resolution stability without making snippet-retrieval requests.

request.query_control_reason: Use one identical identity-only query per package to remove DS-1000 case-query variation and isolate resolver behavior; this does not estimate task-query resolver quality.

design.retry_policy: one direct httpx request per observation; HTTPTransport(retries=0); redirects disabled; no application retry
design.schedule: ten balanced rounds: five forward cyclic orders followed by five reverse cyclic orders; every package occupies each within-round position exactly twice

selection_policy.name: existing automatic quality-guided resolver
ordered_key_maximized: exact normalized candidate title equals canonical library name
selection_policy.tie_behavior: first candidate in Context7 response order, matching Python max and the existing adapter
